newsitem.title: GERMANY: Schenker names new Argentina agents.
newsitem.headline: Schenker names new Argentina agents.

text.p: Global freight forwarder Schenker International AG has expanded its stake in Argentina with two new agents, parent company Schenker-Rhenus AG said.
Schenker International Argentina has signed an agency contract with Estudio de Comercio Exterior, Mendoza, to offer logistics services for western Argentina, it said in a statement on Thursday.

The three-year-old agency is in the Cuyo region close to Santiago de Chile with its export industries. Oil and mining companies are based there and it will also be able to profit from opportunities under the Mercosur agreement, it said.
The statement added that Schenker International Argentina has appointed export/import company Aldo y Luis Marengo & Asociados as its agent for the Cordoba region.
Cordoba is the country's second-largest industrial centre with a strong automotive and suppliers industry and rapid links to Buenos Aires, the statement noted.
The Schenker-Rhenus group has total sales of US$13.6 billion, 650 locations worldwide and 19,800 employees, it added. --Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax +44 171 542 5017
